feature: Full-screen project viewer with in-place tools, clips in projects, image view, Settings
unit_tests: 125 Python and 12 Node tests passed on macOS

browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.card_opens_on_its_image: Harbor card showed its newest edit; the viewer opened on it (3 of 4)
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.immersive_navigation: a tap hid the controls; a swipe moved to the clip and on into the next project with the controls still hidden
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.double_tap_zoom: 2.5x; the photo grew to 975 x 650 on a 390 px screen instead of staying inside its frame
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.compare_while_zoomed: split visible at 2.5x and dragged from 50% to 41.7%; Parent | Original switched the reference
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.press_and_hold: held 520 ms: the original showed with an Original badge; released: back, controls unchanged
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.clip_in_strip: a finished clip is the fourth strip entry; it plays in place and hides image-only tools
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.area_in_place: brush stroke, then Done returned to Edit with a Selected area chip
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.edit_from_viewer: Settings two images per edit plus High: two queued area edits appeared in the strip, the prompt cleared, Stop cancelled one
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.person_and_animate: panels open in place; the photo moves up to stay fully visible
browser_checks_headless_chrome_390px_and.offline: the viewer opens from the phone copy with only Edit enabled and sending disabled
